Context: 5. Procedure Minor Penalties.-

9. the punishment proposed.  
The procedure for the inquiry will be as for major penalty.Rule 16.  
6. When prescribed procedure need not be followed.Following are the special circumstances where the prescribed procedure for inquiry need not be followed:-
- (1) Where a penalty is due to conviction on a criminal charge, or
- (2) Where the Disciplinary Authority is satisfied (reasons should be recorded in writing) that it is not reasonably practicable to hold an enquiry in the manner provided, or
